description_en: Deletes a function. Before deleting a function, delete all triggers associated with the function
description_zh: 删除函数。删除函数前需要先删除函数的触发器
kebab_example: aliyun fc-open delete-function --service-name demoService --function-name demoFunction --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteFunction

parameters.help_en: The value used to ensure that the resource to be modified matches the expected resource. This value is obtained from the response of the Create, Get, and Update operations
parameters.help_zh: 用于确保实际更改的资源和期望更改的资源是一致的，该值来自Create，Get和Update API的响应
parameters.name: if_match

parameters.help_en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: x_fc_account_id

parameters.help_en: The date when the function invocation starts. The format is EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.help_zh: 函数的调用开始日期，格式为EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.name: x_fc_date

parameters.help_en: The invocation ID of the function. This value corresponds to the requestId parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh: 调用函数的ID，与返回参数requestId对应
parameters.name: x_fc_trace_id
